title: Triana flamenco
text: Staying in Hotel Monte Triana this flamenco was 5 minutes away. Fantastic display of dance and music in lovely intimate setting.
author: MarinaFR6268

title: Flamenco show that moves and amazes
text: A very emotional, beautiful show that allows you to connect deeply with the city's culture. I would always recommend it.
author: 88angelamariar

title: Flamenco show not to be missed
text: Flamenco in the heart of Triana was excellent.  The three flamenco dancers and the guitarist put on a passionate performance that demonstrates the origin and emotion of flamenco.   The highlight of our trip.
author: RANCCTx

title: Not perfect, but thoroughly enjoyable!
text: The show lasts around an hour and has a brief intermission - which is perfect. We had a thoroughly enjoyable time and were entertained by the dancing, guitar playing and singing. One member of our group was an ex-dancer and plays the guitar so was more critical, but the rest of us had a blast.

title: Well worth a visit
text: What a wonderful experience, I can highly recommend this flamenco evening. We had already been to a much larger show but really appreciated the intimate setting and the joy with which the dancers performed. We booked seats with a drink, which was good value. I recommend getting there early as there is no reserve seating unless you pay the top price.
author: Ann50uk

title: The soul of flamenco in a corner of Triana
text:
A 100% flamenco experience.

We enjoyed a show full of elegance, passion, and a staging cared for down to the last detail. Great performers who convey flamenco with authenticity and great strength, masterfully combining singing, music, and dance.

All this in a small, intimate, and well-kept venue, which allows you to experience the show in a close and special way, feeling every note, every voice, and every movement.

And doing it in the heart of Triana, Seville, makes the experience even more authentic. A place where flamenco is truly felt and lived.

Flamenco in its purest state, with soul,
author: claustreov
